tiebreakers.description: Player with the highest score in the first row of the scorepad wins.
If still tied, tied players share the victory.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Scoring follows the official scorepad. Game ends when all Character cards are drawn and played from hands. Eight Scoring tiles are randomised each game (four River, four Palace); rows vs counts as listed: Patients, Students, Artefact types, Books, Boats in port, Buildings, Architects, Night Characters; tile multiplier comes from the tile plus your Boats/Architects. Source rulebook is the pre-release draft v2 (Jan 2025) from the publisher; final retail rulebook (BGG file 436335) could not be downloaded, so tiebreak first-row wording and Hospital/Character card bonus scoring should be re-checked. Solo/2-player bot not modelled.
